messages:
Jamie: heads-up — Snowflake / Databricks marketplace credentialing checklist landed on my desk. They want a formal e2e test report, security questionnaire answers, and a brief credentialing doc for the listing. Can partnerships + eng decide owners and timeline?
Arjun: we already have an e2e harness in infra/tests/marketplace-e2e that runs connectors against ephemeral stacks. can adapt for Snowbridge + DBX + vector DBs, but need sample datasets and service creds for automated runs.
Priya: Snow asked specifically for OAuth2 flows, SSO verification, and retention/telemetry proof (3mo logs). they also prefer a signed certification token after the dry-run. I can request partner test accounts but will need a clear test matrix.
Marta: I can own the test matrix and the test report. proposed matrix (initial):
  - ingest full snapshot (50k docs)
  - delta/CDC updates (10k changes)
  - schema evolution (nested fields -> flattened)
  - auth rotation (key rotate + OAuth refresh)
  - telemetry & backpressure (verify metrics, no data loss)
  - vector similarity checks (qdrant)
Arjun: add technical notes: we need a Delta table with nested schema for DBX tests, and a Snow private link test requires a long-lived service user key + network config. CI also needs perms to create ephemeral compute.
Luis: compliance note — verify EU/UK data residency for any customer-supplied samples. add a PII-masking validation step to the matrix. also confirm whether signing token contains any customer identifiers.
Jamie: owners => Marta (tests + report), Arjun (CI + infra changes), Priya (partner creds + partner contacts). timeline: target dry-run in 2 weeks, final certification 1 week after dry-run assuming pass. @deploy-bot can you provision a dedicated env for the run? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: creating environment...
connector-ci: connector-ci: ephemeral env `marketplace-e2e-1744441234` provisioned in us-west-2; queued job 2789 (marketplace-e2e).
Arjun: CI note — the Snow private-link scenario needs a NAT + private endpoint in the test VPC; we'll need network owner approval. Priya can you collect the contact and request a test account that supports private link?
Priya: will do. requesting Snow test account + Databricks workspace with minimal cluster. ETA ~3 business days. will also ask Qdrant for an exportable vector dataset (embedding dims 1536).
Marta: test report template (first draft):
```
Test case | Owner | Steps | Pass criteria | Artifacts
Ingest 50k | Marta | run ingest script | all docs present, checksum match | logs, checksum
CDC 10k | Marta | apply deltas | final state matches expected | diff, logs
Schema evolution | Marta | alter schema + reingest | no crash, mapping applied | error logs
Auth rotation | Arjun/Marta | rotate key/OAuth | no dropped requests | auth logs
Vector recall | Marta | run 20 queries | recall >= 0.9 | result snapshots
Telemetry | Marta/Arjun | synthetic load 200 qps | metrics within SLO | metrics dump
```
Jamie: Marketing heads-up — Sasha asked to coordinate announcement timing. plan: announce marketplace listing 1 week after final cert, only if no regressions. Priya to gather logo/legal permissions.
Arjun: small technical addendum — vector DBs need normalization + deterministic seeding to make recall stable across runs. add that as a precondition. also set ingest throughput target: 200 qps sustained for bulk ingest.
Marta: added: vector normalization test + throughput SLO. will include automated checks in the harness.
Luis: also include KMS key rotation validation for private deployments (proof that rotated keys still decrypt).
Jamie: great. i'll create a calendar invite for daily 15m standups starting tomorrow until dry-run complete. i'll post a shared doc with checklist and owners. thanks everyone :rocket:
